calibration.order: maximise correct clear misses, then lower false clear-miss rate, then lower false-clear rate, then lower tau_match, then higher tau_q, then lower tau_occ
calibration.search: one joint Neyman-Pearson search over the whole predeclared grid tau_q x tau_occ x tau_match (select-v4 correction found in review, 2026-11-03, before any test data and before the freeze: the gate was chosen first and tau_match only under that one gate, so calibration could fail while other grid settings met both constraints)

dev_check.note: FRR <= frr_limit is a check, not an objective: flags are reported and nothing is changed to fix them. Rows for L1 and L2 queries are the result; 'pooled' is a secondary line. all_within_limit is true only if every L1 and L2 row was checked and none is flagged, false if one is flagged, and null if none is but FRR is undefined in some row (listed in 'unchecked'): the check is then incomplete. The rows are resubstitution (the arrangements whose views set the thresholds); the held-out check is the honest estimate.
dev_check.pooled_note: FRR <= frr_limit is a reported policy check (false removal; Step 4 and the held-out check): it never changes a threshold and never gates freeze eligibility. all_within_limit is the pooled result over both environments' episodes and stays the headline; a pooled pass does NOT imply that each environment passed. frr_within_limit_by_environment is each environment's own result (true, false, or null = incomplete); all_environments_within_limit is true only if every one is true, false if one is false, else null.

positions.status: SIM 2026-11-04: the simulated TABLETOP's stops (DEV, not frozen). Written by `python -m sim.tabletop positions`.

sensitivity.note: reported only, never selected; point estimates on this environment's episodes

environments.note: pooled calibration over environments (tabletop wave, step 9; DEV, not frozen): one threshold set from the views of every environment's dev set together; grouped CV leaves one arrangement out across the pool; the bootstrap strata keep each environment's quota classes; each episode replays on its environment's positions, with a cap of N arc steps = N of that environment's nominal steps. Rows pooled over environments give the cap in arc steps only, with no cm and no mean travel in cm (the geometries differ); the per-environment rows give the travel and each cap's cm. The per-environment rows and rates are reported next to the pooled ones; the pooled rows carry the flags and all_within_limit, and a pooled pass does not imply that each environment passed (frr_within_limit_by_environment).

fixed_a_priori.k_note: the plan's 'at least two distinct positions'; any other k runs only as a reported sensitivity (sensitivity.k_values)
fixed_a_priori.lam_note: G and A choose by spread or informativeness alone; travel is limited by the caps, reported as curves; any other lam runs only as a reported sensitivity (sensitivity.lam_values)

held_out_check.note: each fold's thresholds, calibrated without the held-out arrangement, run every policy on that arrangement's episodes; outcomes pooled over the folds. Rates above the limit are reported checks: they never touch eligibility or any threshold. Rows for L1 and L2 queries are the result; 'pooled' is a secondary line.
held_out_check.pooled_note: FRR <= frr_limit is a reported policy check (false removal; Step 4 and the held-out check): it never changes a threshold and never gates freeze eligibility. all_within_limit is the pooled result over both environments' episodes and stays the headline; a pooled pass does NOT imply that each environment passed. frr_within_limit_by_environment is each environment's own result (true, false, or null = incomplete); all_environments_within_limit is true only if every one is true, false if one is false, else null.
